BiblicalUsage: Seled was a son of Nadab, named in the genealogy of Jerahmeel, and the record adds simply that he died without children. His line ends with him, and Scripture says so plainly.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God records even the lines that end, and Seled is remembered because his name is part of the family story.
